title: Tokusatsu Gagaga
titleNative: トクサツガガガ
synopsis: Nakamura Kano is an OL (office lady) with a secret… she’s a “Toku Otaku,” a tokusatsu otaku who is obsessed with live action dramas of heroes, monsters and robots. She thinks they’re “JUST TOO COOL!” She’s so obsessed that she skips out on drinking with colleagues to watch it on TV and collects the DVDs, books and figurines. She lives her life by the code of the tokusatsu heroes, and constantly imagines them to help her through difficult situations. But this isn’t easy when all of her co-workers think that people who like anime and other childish things are weird, and they keep trying to make her socialize. Notes: Nominated to the 21st Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize.

In “Online Game: I Can Evolve Everything,” he gets a second chance at life. Reborn with a burning desire for vengeance, he vows to reclaim everything that was taken from him. When a revolutionary online game arrives, he finds himself at an advantage. No one understands this game better than he does! By getting into the game early and spending heavily, he can acquire a god-level skill known as "Evolve Everything." Now he prepares to exact his revenge. synopsis: I’ve always hated Kazama. We joined the company at the same time and were rivals — I believed I wasn’t inferior to him in any way, but what awaited me at the end of that path was a demotion from my department... In that moment when everything I believed in was shattered, I headed to the company rooftop with a resolve in my heart, but the words that came out of that guy’s mouth were: “Marry me before you jump so I can get the insurance money”. Filled with rage, I went along with Kazama’s scheme, but as I gradually came to understand his charm, I ended up giving in to the moment and sleeping with him. Now, I, a straight guy, am getting corrupted by that scumbag... (Source: Daitosha, translated)

title: Hikari no Densetsu
titleNative: 光の伝説
synonyms: Cynthia ou le Rythme de la Vie
synopsis: It's about a girl named Hikari Kamijou who dreams of becoming a national rhythmic gymnastics champion. Hikari no Densetsu is primarily a love story that it is set in the late 80s junior high school atmosphere. The plot revolves around four characters and how they work to achieve their dreams. Hikari Kamijou, a young, naïve, care-free, young woman who dreams of becoming an Olympic Champion in the sport of rhythmic gymnastics ever since she witnessed a performance of the young Diliana Georgieva (a champion Bulgarian rhythmic gymnast). And while she performs poorly and is not very confidant in her skills as a rhythmic gymnast, she is very passionate about the sport and shows occasional brilliance during her performances. From Wikipedia

synopsis: “Make me a princess!” One day, Yuma Kanbara finds himself in a tough spot, when his younger sister, Ayane, blackmails him with a certain cringe-worthy secret from his past. Her demand? To secure her a spot among the “Hime 6,” the prestigious titles awarded only to the top six candidates in Himegasaki Academy’s famous general election. Determined to claim the throne, Ayane leverages Yuma's weakness to make him “conquer” her rival princess candidates to clear the path to her victory. But winning over the school’s most captivating beauties is no easy task, and Yuuma struggles at every turn… Worse still, as he gets involved with the girls, he finds himself getting tangled up in the increasingly complicated romantic lives of the princesses themselves! With egos laid bare and love and scheming colliding at full force, the most chaotic romantic comedy ever is about to begin! (Source: SB Creative, translated)

titleRomaji: Class no Bocchi Gyaru wo Omochikaeri Shite Seisokei Bijin ni Shiteyatta Hanashi

synonyms: A Story Of Taking Home A Lonely Gal From My Class And Turning Her Into An Elegant Beauty
Class no botti GAL wo omotikaeri shite seisokei-bijin ni shiteyatta hanashi
synopsis: On a rainy night, Akira Akamori, a high school boy about to transfer to a new school, sees his blonde-haired classmate, Aoi Sotome, standing in the park drenched from the rain. “…I don’t have a home anymore.” Though he doesn't know Aoi well at all, Akira couldn’t leave a girl alone in the rain, so he took her home. “Thanks for the help.” “Y- You're welcome…” When Akira hears about Aoi’s complicated situation, he decides to help her and let her live with him until he transfers to his new school. While their new cohabitation arrangement seems a little confusing at first, the two slowly grow close to each other. It is a love story of two people who repeatedly come together and drift apart, like a spinning record.
